+        """Append a value of a parameter to its history, when tracking
+        is enabled. An entry after the first also keeps the value it
+        replaced as ``previous_value``.
+
+        :param name: The name of the parameter.
+        :param value: The value the parameter now has.

+        entry: dict[str, t.Any] = {

+            "source": source,

+            the option is unknown or has no history, or ``None`` if the
+            command does not track changes.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 8.2.2
